name: code-skeptic-scanner-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end layer for Code Skeptic Scanner, driven by its own self-contained Vite harness. Every script names a local binary; none is resolved through npx, which would fall back to the registry when the local one is absent. No script downloads a browser: Playwright 1.44.1's downloader does not verify the TLS chain of the host it fetches from (CVE-2025-59288), so browsers are provisioned out of band from a channel that signs its artifacts. Two fail-closed gates read that provision without fetching: browsers:require resolves and publishes the executable and exits non-zero when there is none, and browsers:verify proves one is present, exiting non-zero when neither PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE nor the Playwright cache holds a launchable Chromium. test:list overrides the reporter so listing cannot overwrite a previous run's JUnit and HTML reports with an all-skipped stub. See docs/testing/DECISION-LOG.md rows D111, D129, D236, D252 and D264.
